title: Long operations run in a workstation service while sessions go on, and the kb MCP server can write
goal: Long operations (land, done, stage-back, sync, check runs, benchmark runs) are submitted to a service on the workstation, or a central one a clone subscribes to as a thin client, and watched through Claude Code's background monitoring, so a session goes on with its next step instead of waiting; and the kb MCP server offers the backlog's write and orchestration commands with the same refusals as the CLI, submitting the long ones to that service
